subject: How to change the table output after processing

messages.author: 23b60abd2aad65e8
messages.subject: How to change the table output after processing
parts:
I wish to upload a csv file to a dataframe,, and display it using renderTable and I can do that easily with the file input functions -
 now I want to click an actionButton, process and clean up the table, and display the results in same space as the first renderTable  - that is replace the old table, with the new one...
 any suggestions how I might do this? Thanks in advance

messages.author: 5712068fdf482d27
messages.subject: How to change the table output after processing
parts:
Use an if statement

E.g

if (uractionbutton==0) {
...show original table...
} else {
...process code...
...show the processed table...
}

U need more complicated code if u want to upload another file in the same session.
